messages:
jordan: Starting staggered v2 rollout now. Plan: NA -> EU -> APAC, 10m waves, small percentage ramps. Pin list for clients attached. Any blockers?

priya: Can we hold EU by 15m? Mobile SDK 1.4 still on v1 for a couple of large tenants — want to avoid client breaks.

mike: Confirmed mobile pin for tenant-acme and tenant-orchid, will update deploy-bot exclude list now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started rollout job r-1769999998 at 2026-03-20T17:35:00Z. phase=na_wave_1 traffic=5% status=running :rocket:

jordan: Monitoring p50/p95 and error-rates. SLO: p95 < 250ms. Alert if errors > 1% or auth failures spike.

lina: Heads up — v2 changed timestamp header handling (X-Client-Ts) is now case-sensitive, which older mobile runtimes may not send correctly. We should warn SDK teams.

priya: Adding note to release notes and pinging @sdk-oncall. Putting a migration callout on the v2 release page: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2

kevin: If we need to rollback, manual rollback steps (ops):
```
# pin traffic back to v1
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/rollbacks -d '{"job":"r-1769999998","target":"v1"}'
# abort current job
deployctl abort r-1769999998
```

mike: 👍 I'll watch deploy-bot events and update exclude set.

deploy-bot: phase na_wave_1 completed. healthy=true errors=0.3% traffic=5% latency_p95=210ms

jordan: Good. Proceed to EU in 15m. priya — can you confirm SDK note landed before EU start? :eyes: 

priya: Landed and pinged @sdk-oncall. Will post a short slack blurb to #general after EU starts.

lina: Also flagged a telemetry check — watch for client-version spike as some tenants may auto-upgrade to 2.0.x then 2.1.x.

kevin: If anything looks off, we rollback immediately. Ops runbook: https://playbooks.internal/deploys/rollbacks

jordan: Thanks team :thumbsup:
